responsibility: Specializes the RISC-V target for FreeBSD ELF systems at the driver/spec level. It sets C type defaults such as wchar_t, defines FreeBSD-specific CPP and link specs including dynamic-linker handling, startfile search prefixes, and shared/static linking conventions, so GCC invokes the assembler and linker with the ABI and runtime conventions expected by FreeBSD rather than the generic ELF or GNU/Linux environments.
